scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors red,cyan "cd apps/api && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --workspace web"
